title: Department with the highest average salary
prompt: Return the department with the highest average salary, along with that average as a column named avg_salary.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE staff3 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT, salary INTEGER); INSERT INTO staff3 VALUES (1,'A','Eng',90000),(2,'B','Eng',110000),(3,'C','Sales',60000),(4,'D','Sales',65000),(5,'E','HR',50000),(6,'F','HR',55000);
reference_sql: SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM staff3 GROUP BY department ORDER BY avg_salary DESC LIMIT 1;
